events.subject: Stay Safe Online: Important Security Tips from {{ticket.brand.name}}
events.body:
Dear {{ticket.requester.first_name}},

At {{ticket.brand.name}}, your trust and security are our top priorities. As a company providing online travel support—including visa document preparation, interview scheduling, and assistance with U.S. Embassy accounts—we take every step to ensure your personal information is protected.

Please take a moment to review the following important tips to protect yourself against phishing scams and online fraud:

How to Stay Safe:

  • Only trust emails and messages from official {{ticket.brand.name}} addresses (ending in @{{ticket.brand.name}}.com). If something looks suspicious, contact us before clicking.
  • Never share your U.S. Embassy account credentials with anyone. We create and deliver these credentials securely—{{ticket.brand.name}} will never ask you to re-enter them through any third-party link, except when accessing the official U.S. Embassy website.
  • Be cautious of ads, pop-ups, or messages claiming to be from the U.S. Embassy, {{ticket.brand.name}}, or other official sources. Always verify the source before clicking.
  • Protect your passport account details, credit card information, and saved documents on your device with strong passwords and updated antivirus software.
  • Avoid downloading attachments or clicking links from unknown senders. These can be used to steal personal data or infect your device.
  • Look for small signs of phishing: strange URLs, poor grammar, or urgent language asking for immediate action.
  • Only fill out official forms using links we provide or those hosted on .gov domains or verified {{ticket.brand.name}} channels.

We're Here to Help

If you ever suspect that your account or personal data may have been compromised, please contact our support team immediately at support@{{ticket.brand.name}}.com

We’re committed to helping you travel with peace of mind and will continue to work diligently to protect your information.

Stay safe,
The {{ticket.brand.name}} Team
Your Trusted Partner in Global Travel
